title: Automation Dashboard
description: n8n automation at a glance: workflow health, executions per day, failing workflows and recent runs.
insights: Shows the last 14 days of n8n executions: success rate, errors per day, slowest and most failing workflows.
Sample data is fictional and marked as such; live data comes from your n8n Cloud instance via npm run sync:automation -- --live.
Only ids, names, tags, status and timings are read from n8n; execution payloads are never loaded.
prompt: Bundled example: Automation Dashboard for n8n (static, data embedded by npm run sync:automation).
